description: You are a software developer with RSI who uses Talon Voice for hands-free coding in Visual Studio Code. The community Talon configuration is installed at C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community, but it has no VS Code-specific voice module. Create a complete VS Code voice module consisting of two files in C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community\apps\vscode\: (1) vscode.talon — a context-scoped .talon file that activates only when VS Code is the active application, containing at least 10 voice commands across navigation, editing, and code actions categories; (2) vscode.py — a Python actions file that defines at least 3 custom action implementations using the Talon Module/Context API. The commands must be functional and use proper Talon syntax. Save both files when done.
